reason: Selected HotPotQA experiments support optimizing task-specific pipeline demonstrations rather than copying static few-shot examples.

candidates.title: Optimize demonstrations for the actual multi-hop pipeline
candidates.rule: For retrieval QA, compare static few-shot examples with demonstrations bootstrapped for the full query-generation and answering pipeline using a task metric.
candidates.passage: bootstrap again proves to be very effective at raising its quality relative to its fewshot variant for both LMs.
candidates.finding: For the multi-hop program, test exact match rises from 31.2 to 39.6 with GPT-3.5 and from 31.3 to 36.4 with Llama2-13b-chat. These compare the same program with different compilation strategies.
candidates.conditions: ColBERTv2 retrieval over the official Wikipedia abstracts; sampled train/development data and a separately reserved official validation subset for testing.
candidates.limitations: Historical models and a small sample; optimization adds cost and depends on the metric. This does not establish modern library behavior, universal optimizer superiority or robustness outside the QA distribution.
candidates.validation_test: With a fixed retriever and program, compare static and bootstrapped demonstrations on a final disjoint question set; include compile spend, answer quality and evidence retrieval.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
